correctness.rationale: Every projection can be averaged over m independent pair swaps, producing P_alpha without greater norm; exact column norms yield F_j=max(1,|alpha_j|)+((R-r_j)/r_j)|alpha_j|. The lower bound 1+1/H holds for all coefficient signs, and alpha_j=(r_j/(R-r_j))/H attains it. Strict Jensen gives equal-weight rigidity; symbolic differentiation gives the one-defect law. A direct proof has full universal quantifiers. The bundled standard-library checker passed 120 exact instances; an independent unrestricted-projection LP passed 50 numeric cases.
